_comment: Administrator registry. Addresses below were collected by web research on 2026-05-20 and are NOT human-verified -- address_verified is false for every entry. Confirm each address against the administrator's current cancellation instructions before mailing certified mail. Use 'python -m refunds.registry_tool' to maintain this file.

administrators.name: Assurant
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- afasinc.com Assurant Dealer Services cancellation request
administrators.notes: Fax (832) 813-0538. Send written notice with a copy of the service contract and an odometer statement. Payment-plan financed products may route to Service Payment Plan instead.

administrators.name: EasyCare (APCO)
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- easycare.com cancellation request form

administrators.name: Fidelity Warranty Services
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- fidelitywarrantyservices.com customer support; FWS cancellation form
administrators.notes: FWS also accepts cancellations returned through the selling dealership. Street address: 350 Jim Moran Blvd, Deerfield Beach, FL 33442.

administrators.name: GWC Warranty
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- gwcwarranty.com consumer FAQs and cancellation request form
administrators.notes: Dealer-purchased contracts are cancelled through the selling dealer; contracts bought direct can be cancelled with GWC. Overnight address: Showroom Level, 40 Coal Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702. Requests must be received within 15 days of the cancellation date.

administrators.name: JM&A Group
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- legal.jmagroup.com National Cancellation Form
administrators.notes: JM&A cancellations are typically submitted by the selling dealer; a direct cancellation form also exists. Shares a P.O. box with Fidelity Warranty Services. Allow three to four weeks for processing.

administrators.name: Safe-Guard Products International
administrators.notes: Address shown is the corporate headquarters; no dedicated cancellation mailing address was found. Safe-Guard also offers an online cancellation portal.

administrators.name: Zurich
administrators.source: Web research 2026-05-20 -- zurichna.com auto owner FAQ; Zurich F&I cancellation form
administrators.notes: Refunds are typically issued through the selling dealership; if a lien exists the refund is sent to the lienholder. Fax (913) 664-3247.
